feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector and condition predicates for colorless creatures, untapped creatures, mana-value equality or parity, names taken from a target, tokens put there this turn, controlled Equipment, spell origin, colors of mana spent, shared colors, distinct powers or mana values, targeted commanders, and exiled-flashback target zones.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events for cycling this card, a Saga's final chapter, playing a land from exile, proliferating, combat damage to planeswalkers or battles, any damage from an enchanted creature, excess noncombat damage, becoming the target of a spell on the stack, damage naming the source creature, drawing-only trigger doubling, and delayed combat-damage triggers.

feature: Conditional rule statics and permissions
description: Add rule statics for untap limits, cost increases on all spells, granting flash or instant-speed equip, convoke filters, crew-power bonuses, forced blocking, legend-rule exemptions, spell-count limits, skipped steps, and activated-ability or turn-scoped cost changes.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add effects and triggers for the Ring tempting you, earthbend, cloak, committing a crime, villainous choices, connive on chosen creatures, dice rolls, coin-flip loops, votes and random player or opponent choices.

feature: Token copy color, type and cost overrides
description: Let token copies and becomes-a-copy effects carry overrides: replaced colors and types, subtype and keyword additions, extra triggered abilities, counters, base power and toughness, tapped state and linked exile.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player-scope and chooser fields so shuffles, per-opponent targets, defender or opponent choices, controller-chosen optional damage, hand exiling and discard-then-draw apply per player, and allow optional effects on activated abilities.

feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Let counts, cost reductions, mill amounts, counter-unless payments, doubling repeats and selector limits take the announced X or another computed Value (mana value X or less, X counters removed as a cost, domain count, life total, sacrificed creature's mana value).

feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values that read the toughness, power or colors of a targeted or destroyed creature, the total mana value or power of several chosen or exiled objects, cards returned, event-player land counts, creature types in a chosen graveyard, and total counters of all kinds.

feature: Alternative-cost keyword mechanics
description: Model warp, plot, encore, harmonize, mayhem, sneak, web-slinging, replicate grants and fast healing.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add conditions and values for what happened this turn: life gained, cards drawn, attacking, artifacts entering, a creature dying, and the first time a permanent was tapped or got counters.

feature: Granted statics and characteristic-setting effects
description: Add effects that grant static abilities, activated abilities with costs, keywords to spells, hand-zone cycling, until-end-of-turn subtypes, swapped or set base power and toughness, and abilities removed until end of turn.

feature: Life totals and game-result effects
description: Add effects that set or exchange life totals, double a controller's life, and make a player win or lose the game or stop winning.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost components and alternatives: discard a typed card, return a creature to hand, either/or additional costs, sacrifice-lands entry replacement, exile a typed graveyard card, and unless-pays with non-mana payments.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, choose-a-kind-then-reveal, exile-two-face-down, count-matched reveals and library or graveyard repositioning (return same-name cards, ordered exile-sacrifice-return, search to hand, mass shuffles).

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add keywords and keyword-like fields the schema lacks or cannot grant: poisonous, partner, skulk, myriad, afterlife, umbra armor, protection from a subtype.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add any-number, announced-count, up-to-one and per-opponent target slots, including tapping, gaining control, goading and attaching each chosen object.

feature: Damage prevention and replacement variants
description: Add replacement effects for life gain becoming life loss, draws becoming exile, token creation becoming copies, added noncombat damage, exile instead of dying, and combat damage prevention to your creatures.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add entry options for returned and put-onto-battlefield cards (tapped, attacking, optional, any number from the top of the library) and effects that attach a targeted Equipment to a creature.

feature: Control changes and durations tied to controlling the source
description: Add durations such as for as long as you control the source and control-changing statics, effects that exchange control, and permanent indestructible or no-untap grants tied to the source.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add free or alternative casting of cards from graveyards, hands and the top of the library with cost riders, mana-value limits by the triggering spell, noncreature-only limits and turn-long play permissions.

feature: Reference to the card moved by the previous effect
description: Let follow-up effects refer to the object a previous effect moved, destroyed or returned, for keywords, counters, power-based damage, delayed copies and stun counters.

feature: Counterspell variants
description: Let counter effects put the spell on top of the library, counter every opposing spell or ability, counter activated or triggered abilities, cast the exiled spell free, and add any-color mana from the countered spell's mana value.

feature: Mana production and spending restrictions
description: Add mana abilities that read a creature's current power, state-derived additional costs per permanent, and name-based mana amounts.

feature: Unrecognized ability-word lines the patch cannot replace
description: The patch can only append triggers, so a labeled ability line already parsed into a generic ability cannot be marked handled.

feature: Withheld: smoke game did not finish
description: Refusal written by the main thread because the compiled patch's smoke game never finished.

feature: one-off
description: Lines needing a bespoke mechanic found on a single card.
